This '''scroll''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] manuscript written in the [[Sith (language)|Sith]] language, with a few notes in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] found it in the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]' camp on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], just after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]]. After [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] rid the camp of mercenaries seeking treasure, he gained valuable knowledge from this scroll. The scroll contained a compilation of the history and teachings of [[Freedon Nadd]], numerous [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith spells]], and some writings from [[Qordis]], including the location of [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd|Nadd's tomb]].<ref name="RoT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>
